title: docsrs-cli readme success data
description: Payload under envelope.data for command readme. Outer envelope always has schema_version=1, ok, command, duration_ms. Optional fields are omitted when absent (never JSON null).

resolved_version.description: Omitted when docs.rs did not resolve a concrete version (never JSON null)

cache_hit.description: True when the HTTP response body was served from the local disk cache
